description: Land Acquisition - Wariyapola ward No. 10 Diyabubula Matale D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content is a Land Acquisition Notice published under the Land Acquisition Act. It specifically declares that a particular piece of land is needed for a public purpose and will be acquired. The content provides detailed land descriptions, boundaries, and location information. This falls squarely under Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters." While it mentions a minister's name, this is incidental to the primary land acquisition purpose and does not include detailed portfolio responsibilities that would trigger a government classification.
